answer: A one-way admission toll gates the forge: each new agent posts a non-refundable 240-credit bond before its first umber is counted; four established peers must co-sign the same umber within 72h before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each kernel-style fake costs one real umber window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the forge ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x umber window; zero recovery on flag.
